name: Toggl Track
desc: Toggl Track is a time tracking application that allows users to track their daily activities across different platforms. Works with classic Toggl Track and Toggl 2.0 accounts.

actions.name: create_client
actions.description: Create a new client in a workspace.

actions.name: create_project
actions.description: Create a new project in a workspace.

actions.name: create_task
actions.description: Create a new task under a project.

actions.name: create_tag
actions.description: Create a new tag in the workspace.

actions.name: create_time_entry
actions.description: Create a new time entry in a workspace.

actions.name: start_time_entry
actions.description: Start a new time entry (live timer).

actions.name: stop_time_entry
actions.description: Stops the currently running time entry.

actions.name: find_user
actions.description: Find a user in a workspace by their name or email.

actions.name: find_project
actions.description: Find a project in a workspace by its name.

actions.name: find_task
actions.description: Find a task by name and status.

actions.name: find_client
actions.description: Find a client by name or status in a workspace.

actions.name: find_tag
actions.description: Find a tag by name in a workspace.

actions.name: find_time_entry
actions.description: Find time entries by description.

actions.name: get_client
actions.description: Get a client by its ID.

actions.name: update_client
actions.description: Update the name, notes, or external reference of a client.

actions.name: delete_client
actions.description: Permanently delete a client from a workspace.

actions.name: get_project
actions.description: Get a project by its ID.

actions.name: update_project
actions.description: Update the settings of a project.

actions.name: update_tag
actions.description: Rename a tag.

actions.name: delete_tag
actions.description: Permanently delete a tag from a workspace.

actions.name: get_time_entry
actions.description: Get a time entry by its ID.

actions.name: get_current_time_entry
actions.description: Get the time entry that is running right now, if any.

actions.name: update_time_entry
actions.description: Update a single time entry.

actions.name: delete_time_entry
actions.description: Delete a time entry.

actions.name: search_detailed_report
actions.description: Search all time entries of a workspace in a date range (detailed report).

actions.name: list_workspaces
actions.description: List the workspaces you belong to.

actions.name: get_workspace
actions.description: Get the details of a workspace.

actions.name: list_organization_users
actions.description: List the members of an organization.

actions.name: invite_user
actions.description: Invite someone by email to an organization and workspace.

actions.name: add_user_to_project
actions.description: Add a workspace member to a project.

actions.name: create_group
actions.description: Create a group (team) in an organization.

actions.name: delete_group
actions.description: Delete a group (team) from an organization.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_client
triggers.description: Fires when a new client is created in a workspace.

triggers.name: new_workspace
triggers.description: Fires when a workspace is created or updated (Toggl only supports workspace updated events).

triggers.name: new_project
triggers.description: Fires when a new project is added.

triggers.name: new_task
triggers.description: Fires when a new task is created.

triggers.name: new_time_entry
triggers.description: Fires when a new time entry is added (with optional project/task filter).

triggers.name: new_time_entry_started
triggers.description: Fires when a new time entry is started and is currently running.

triggers.name: new_tag
triggers.description: Triggers when a new tag is created
